items.title: Green Lantern Ring
items.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCeased; Arrowverse; Arrowverse: Earth-12; Arrowverse: Earth-D; DCU; Justice League vs. Godzilla vs. Kong; Absolute Universe
items.summary: A '''Green Lantern Ring''', also known as a '''Power Ring''', is a piece of jewelry that grants the wearer incredible and incomprehensible powers and abilities by harnessing willpower. They are considered by some to be the most powerful weapons in the known universe.

items.title: Xantha Charge
items.summary: '''Xantha Charges''' are weapons used against Green Lanterns.

items.title: Kryptonite
items.reality: Earth-One; Earth-Two; New Earth; Prime Earth; Donnerverse; Smallville (TV Series); Arrowverse: Earth-38; Arrowverse; Arkhamverse; DCAU; DC Extended Universe; Injustice; DCU
items.creators: | First = Adventures of Superman (Radio Series) Episode: The Meteor from Krypton
items.summary: DC lore entity: Kryptonite

items.title: Lasso of Truth
items.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Multiverse; Wonder Woman (TV Series); DC Extended Universe
items.creators: William Moulton Marston; Harry G. Peter
items.summary: The '''Lasso of Truth''' is Wonder Woman's primary tool and weapon, a magical golden lariat that forces anyone captured within it to obey the wielder's commands and tell the truth.

items.title: Lasso of Lightning
items.summary: The '''Lasso of Lightning''' is the primary tool and weapon of Cassandra Sandsmark in her role as Wonder Girl.

items.title: Green Lantern Power Battery
items.summary: '''Power Batteries''' are constantly charged by the Central Power Battery to manually fuel about 7200 individual Green Lantern Rings.

items.title: Trick Arrows
items.summary: In his career as Green Arrow, Oliver Queen has custom designed many unique arrowheads, many of which are interchangeable and can be used for any size arrow shaft.

items.title: Medusa Mask
items.summary: The '''Medusa Mask''' can manipulate the emotions of others, matching the appearance the mask takes (sad face, happy face etc.). It is the source of the Psycho-Pirate's powers.

items.title: T-Spheres
items.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; Arrowverse; DCU
items.summary: '''T-Spheres''' are spherical electronic accessories commonly used by the JSA member Michael Holt aka Mister Terrific. The T Spheres are usualy found hovering around Mr. Terrific.

items.title: Black Bison's Coup-Stick
items.summary: The coup-stick was one of two mystical items wielded by the super-villain known as Black Bison.

items.title: Black Bison's Talisman
items.summary: The talisman was one of two mystical items wielded by the super-villain known as Black Bison (the other item being the Bison Cult coup-stick.

items.title: Thermafrost Freezer
items.summary: The '''Thermafrost Freezer''' was a freezer unit that was responsible for the creation of the super-villain Killer Frost.

items.title: Ghostdancing (drug)
items.summary: '''Ghostdancing''' was the name attributed to a liquid narcotic designed to expand human consciousness.

items.title: Cosmic Treadmill
items.summary: Barry Allen built the '''Cosmic Treadmill''' so that he could travel through time by use of super-speed.

items.title: Nth Metal
items.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; DCeased; Dark Multiverse; Arrowverse; Arrowverse: Earth-38; DCU
items.summary: '''Nth metal''' (also called '''ninth metal''') is a special metal with gravity-negating effects. A step ahead of the Eighth Metal yet one league behind the Xth.

items.title: Helmet of Fate
items.reality: Earth-Two; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth; Earth 2; DCAU; Smallville (TV Series); Arrowverse; DC Animated Movie Universe; Earth-16; Injustice; DC Extended Universe
items.summary: The '''Helmet of Fate''' is an ancient, and extremely powerful magical object.

items.title: Red Jar of Calythos
items.summary: '''The Red Jar of Calythos''' is one of three magical items that corresponds to the impish brothers known as the Demons Three.

items.title: Silver Wheel of Nyorlath
items.summary: '''The Silver Wheel of Nyorlath''' is one of three magical items that corresponds to the impish brothers known as the Demons Three.

items.title: Spear of Destiny
items.reality: Earth-Two; New Earth; Prime Earth; Dakotaverse; DCAU; Arrowverse
items.first_appearance: Picture Stories from the Bible New Testament Vol 1 2
items.summary: The '''Spear of Destiny''', the spear used to pierce the side of Jesus Christ, was a powerful magical artifact.

items.title: Gauntlet of Atlas
items.summary: The '''Gauntlet of Atlas''' magnifies its wearer's strength by a factor of ten.

items.title: Green Bell of Uthool
items.summary: '''The Green Bell of Uthool''' is one of three magical items that corresponds to the impish brothers known as the Demons Three.

items.title: Eternity Book
items.summary: DC lore entity: Eternity Book

items.title: Amulet of Anubis
items.reality: Earth-Two; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth
items.summary: The '''Amulet of Anubis''' was one of the magical items used by Doctor Fate.

items.title: Cloak of Destiny
items.reality: Earth-Two; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Earth-16; Prime Earth; Post-Rebirth
items.summary: The '''Cloak of Destiny''' is one of the vestments of Fate, worn by those who assume the role of Doctor Fate, along with the Amulet of Anubis and the Helmet of Fate.

items.title: Claw of Horus
items.summary: DC lore entity: Claw of Horus

items.title: Entropy Aegis
items.summary: The Aegis of Entropy is a suit of armor powered from entropy that was designed by Darkseid.

items.title: Blackout Bomb
items.summary: A '''Blackout Bomb''' is a small, round pellet developed by the late Doctor Charles McNider.

items.title: Anti-Life Equation
items.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Sphere of the Gods; Prime Earth; DCeased; Future State; Arrowverse; DC Extended Universe; Dark Multiverse; Earth-16
items.summary: The '''Anti-Life Equation''' was a transcendental mathematical formula originally said to allow those who knew it to dominate the will of any sentient race; this is the ultimate goal of Darkseid.

items.title: Orb of Ra
items.summary: DC lore entity: Orb of Ra

items.title: Sandals of Hermes
items.reality: Earth-S; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
items.summary: The '''Telaria''' are the winged sandals of the Greek god Hermes and his Roman counterpart Mercury.

items.title: Worlogog
items.summary: The '''Worlogog''' is part of the cosmology of the Fourth World, and apparently native to Earth.

items.title: Universe Orb
items.summary: The '''Universe Orb''' contains the history of the multiverses. Its contents were gathered by Harbinger.

items.title: Magic Sphere
items.reality: Earth-Two; Super Friends; New Earth; Prime Earth; DC Animated Movie Universe
items.creators: William Moulton Marston; Harry G. Peter
items.summary: The '''Magic Sphere''' was a large disk-shaped device located in Queen Hippolyta's palace on Paradise Island, a gift from the goddess Athena that allows the Amazons to observe events in Man's World, including past, present, and even future occurrences.

They are most prominently used by the Batman of Earth 66, who always carried a vast array of spray containers in his Utility Belt. There are several known types of Batspray with different uses, including amnesia gas and the infamous shark repellent spray.

items.title: Joker's Joy Buzzer
items.summary: Joker's '''joy buzzer''' was a prank tool used by the clown prince of crime.

items.title: Orange Lantern Power Battery
items.summary: The '''Orange Lantern Central Power Battery''' channels the orange light of avarice.

items.title: Claw of Aelkhünd
items.summary: The '''Claw of Aelkhünd''' is a mystical artifact which dates back to the ice age.

items.title: Necronomicon
items.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; DCAU; DC Extended Universe; Prime Earth
items.summary: The '''Necronomicon''', also known as the '''Book of the Dead''', is a legendary, mythical grimoire (a textbook of magic) that has appeared in several different realities.

items.title: Orange Lantern Ring
items.summary: Weapon of the Orange Lantern Corps, an '''Orange Lantern Ring''' is powered by the orange light of avarice.

items.summary: The '''Holy Grail''' is said to be one of the most infamous and sought after of arcane holy relics.

items.title: Bio-Restorative Formula
items.summary: The '''Bio-Restorative Formula''' was the invention of chemist Alec Holland. The formula was designed to stimulate hormonal growth in plant life, enabling plants to grow in hostile terrain.

items.title: Sword of Sin
items.summary: The '''Sword of Sin''' along with its sister sword, Sword of Salvation was used by the Order of Purity's Azrael since Geoffrey de Cantonna first donned the Suit of Sorrows after the Crusades.

items.title: Sword of Salvation
items.summary: The '''Sword of Salvation''' along with its sister sword, Sword of Sin was used by the Order of Purity's Azraels since Geoffrey de Cantonna first donned the Suit of Sorrows after the Crusades.

items.title: Dilustel
items.summary: '''Dilustel''' is a highly durable, extra-dimensional metallic substance with a high melting point with a connection to the Quantum Field.

items.title: Illium 349
items.summary: '''Illium 349''' was an extremely rare, radioactive element used exclusively and sparingly in Enlarging Rays to restore shrunken beings to full size.

items.title: Flower of Wrath
items.summary: The '''Flower of Wrath''' is a ancient Martian torture device.

items.title: Archer rifle
items.summary: The Archer rifle was commisioned by the New Krypton Military Guild when they realised that their existing equipment would be insufficient if they faced a superpowered foe.

items.title: B13 Technology
items.summary: After Brainiac 13 tried to take over Metropolis and turned it into "The City of the Future", most pre-existing electronics, computers and technology were advanced and left with '''"B13 Technology"'''.

items.title: Black Mercy
items.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; DCAU; Arrowverse: Earth-38; Prime Earth
items.summary: '''Black Mercy''', scientific name ''Ater Clementia'', is a plant that creates a dream of a person's perfect life by tapping into the pleasure centers of a person's brain, while keeping the victim totally paralyzed.

items.title: Vitamin 2-X
items.summary: '''Vitamin 2-X''' was a chemical that empowered Dan Garret, the first Blue Beetle.

items.title: Kryptonian Regeneration Matrix
items.summary: The '''Kryptonian Regeneration Matrix''' is Kryptonian technology designed to resurrect Kryptonians who have experienced discorporation.

items.title: Black Casebook
items.summary: The '''Black Casebook''' is a record of Batman's earlier adventures that featured otherworldly, supernatural, or otherwise inexplicable elements as some of Batman's secret projects.

items.title: Gene Bomb
items.summary: The '''Gene Bomb''' was a device secretly created by a renegade Dominator scientist of low caste in the Alien Alliance during their invasion of Earth to negate the effects of the metagene and disable the powers of dormant and active metahumans.

items.title: Painting That Ate Paris
items.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; Doom Patrol (TV Series)
items.summary: The '''Painting That Ate Paris''' was a mysterious untitled painting with many levels that had the ability to absorb anyone or anything near it when activated by a contradiction or absurdity.

items.title: The Atom's Farewell
items.summary: '''''The Atom's Farewell''''' is a non-fiction book by Norman Brawler as told to him by Ray Palmer and Jean Loring, documenting Palmer's life as the Atom and focusing on his adventures in Morlaidh.

items.title: Multi-purpose Intercept/Reconnaissance Vehicle
items.summary: The M.I.R.V., or Multi-purpose Intercept/Reconnaissance Vehicle, is the Wildcats' warplane.

items.title: Time Pool
items.summary: The Time Pool is an invention of Ivy Town University Professor Alpheus Hyatt.

items.title: Batman Diary
items.first_appearance: America vs. the Justice Society Vol 1 1
items.summary: The '''Batman Diary''' was a fake diary created by the Earth-Two Batman that accused the Justice Society of America of treason.

items.title: A Blasphemous Mythology: The Religion of Crime
items.creators: Greg Rucka; Eric Trautmann; Steve Lieber;
items.first_appearance: Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood #1
items.summary: '''''A Blasphemous Mythology: The Religion of Crime''''' was a popular nonfiction book written by Stanton T. Carlyle that denounces the Crime Bible and the Religion of Crime as a hoax.

items.title: Mask of the Manhunter
items.summary: ''Mask of the Manhunter'' is a biography of Paul Kirk.

items.title: New Genesis Device
items.summary: The '''New Genesis Device''' was a combat simulator built by the New Gods on New Genesis designed to test the full physical limits of subjects without actually hurting them should they fail its challenges.

items.title: Neurotrol

items.summary: '''Neurotrol''' was a hallucogenic drug.

items.summary: DC lore entity: Power Baton

items.title: Doom Clock

items.title: Javelin-7
items.first_appearance: Justice League (TV Series) Episode: In Blackest Night, Part I
items.summary: The '''Javelin-7''' was a hyperspace capable ship designed and engineered by Batman for use by the Justice League.

items.title: Planet-Eater
items.summary: The Planet-Eater is a Warworld like device created by Brainiac. It destroys planets and uses the energy to create a new planet within itself.

items.title: Project "Alien Farm"
items.summary: '''Project: Alien Farm''' was an experiment run by Lex Luthor for Project 7734.

items.title: Dragon's Claw
items.summary: The '''Dragon's Claw''' is a small jade amulet owned by Richard Dragon.

items.summary: DC lore entity: Tellurium

items.summary: DC lore entity: The Logoz

items.summary: '''Osoito''' is a teddy bear that Bane owned throughout his upbringing in Peña Duro.

items.title: Star-Gliders

items.title: Impulse (Earth-9)

items.title: Kusar Blade

items.title: Black Hood (Impact)
items.summary: '''The Black Hood''' is actually an item, a hood, that turns people into '''The Black Hood''' when donned. Many people have donned The Black Hood, including Wayne Sidmonson, Giles "Hit" Coffee, and Nathan Cray.

items.title: Mutajek 9-9

items.title: Red Tornado (Earth-9)

items.title: Destroyer
items.summary: left|thumb|The Destroyer Odin, Zeus, and Vishnu, known as the Skyfathers of their respective pantheons, confronted Earth's Third Host of Celestials. items.first_appearance: Power Man and Iron Fist Vol 1 100

items.title: Motyka Bone
items.summary: The '''Motyka Bone''' was a large bone discovered in the Savage Land by members of the Karem Tribe who regarded it as sacred or cursed because people who touched it often disappeared in a burst of light and were never seen again. It was actually the disguised Earth terminal of an inter-galactic teleportation system created by the alien Nuwali.

The beautiful tapestry represented three stories from Greek mythology, namely the love relationship between Aphrodite and Ares behind her husband Hephaestus, the love relationship between Zeus transformed into a swan and the beautiful Leda and finally the transformation into a Gorgon of Medusa by Athena for having had a love affair inside her temple. items.title: Tyrannus's Subterranean Transport
items.summary: Tyrannus's Subterranean Transport was a transport vehicle used by Tyrannus to move between Subterranea and the surface world. He used the transport to kidnap Betty Ross before the transport was destroyed by Hulk. Another of the transports was later used by Hulk, Betty, and Rick Jones to escape Subterranea.

items.title: Tyrannus's Ground Transport
items.summary: Tyrannus's Ground Transport was a vehicle used by Tyrannus for transport above ground. It was used by Tyrannus when he kidnapped Betty Ross.

items.title: Tyrannus's Paralyzer Ray
items.summary: Tyrannus's Paralyzer Ray was a ray gun used by Tyrannus to neutralize the Hulk when he attacked Tyrannus after defeating a robot in the Subterranea gladiator pit.

items.title: General Fang's Electric Cage
items.summary: General Fang's Electric Cage was a cage-like device used to trap the Hulk when he visited Lhasa to fight General Fang and his invasion force. The cage was successful at containing the Hulk until Rick Jones was able to deactivate it and free the Hulk.

items.title: Vibereaux's Hole Measuring Machine
items.summary: Vibereaux's Hole Measuring Machine was a large rideable machine that could be used to measure holes for oil wells. Alton Vibereaux invtened the machine and was commissioned to use it over the San Andreas Fault but upon doing so, was pulled deep into the Earth where he was exposed to extreme heat and his machine's nuclear fuel and became Vibro.

items.title: Wolverine Jet
items.summary: The Wolverine Jet was a specialized truck used by Suprema and Scarbo and used to transport troops in order to take control of New York's crime scene. Eventually Captain America stole the truck and used it to defeat Suprema and Scarbo.Captain America Vol 1 123

items.title: Magnetic Intensifier
items.summary: The Magnetic Intensifier was a device used by Magneto to enhance his abilities to allow him to control any metal on Asteroid M during a confrontation with the X-Men.X-Men Vol 1 5

items.title: Dart Grenade
items.summary: The Dart Grenade was a weapon used by Magneto during a confrontation with the X-Men, which they dodged.X-Men Vol 1 5

items.title: Energizer
items.summary: The Energizer was a device used by Magneto to enhance his abilities to allow him to attack Humans with their own missiles.X-Men Vol 1 1

items.summary: The Magnetic Plane was a magnetically powered plane designed to silently descend to Earth and transport the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants to Asteroid M.X-Men Vol 1 5

items.title: Drone Pick-Up Capsule
items.summary: The Drone Pick-Up Capsule was a magnetically powered plane designed to silently descend to Earth and transport the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants to Asteroid M. It was summoned to Earth by Toad when he was captured by the X-Men and used by the group to get to the asteroid.X-Men Vol 1 5

items.title: Undersea Racer
items.summary: The Undersea Racer was a small craft that Namor used to travel from the Atlantean Imperial Palace to Magneto's Island.X-Men Vol 1 6

items.title: The Last Door
items.summary: To better serve the world, the Scarlet Witch created '''The Last Door''' in a small mystical shop in Lotkill, New York. Part seeking spell and part portal, The Last Door finds those in greatest need and brings them to the Scarlet Witch's Emporium so she can help them.Scarlet Witch Vol 3 1 One of the first individuals to come through the Last Door was Darcy. However, Darcy refused to reveal why she came through the Last Door, so instead of immediately helping he

items.title: Rings of Rankhor
items.summary: The Rings of Rankhor were owned by Cyrus Black and given to three children to transform them into versions of the Hulk, Captain America, and Spider-Man. The transformed kids attacked Nighthawk until he was able to trick the kids into removing the Rings.Tales to Astonish Vol 2 13

items.title: Paste Cannon
items.summary: The Paste Cannon was a cannon that shot Paste-Pot Pete's paste. He used it to snare a U.S. military missile after it had been fired.

items.title: Delta-Cosmic Missile
items.summary: The Delta-Cosmic Missile was a compact missile developed by the U.S. Army. It was captured by Paste-Pot Pete using his Paste Cannon. While fighting the Human Torch, he managed to paste Johnny to the missile as it was launched but he was able to burn through the paste prior to it landing and exploding in the ocean.

items.title: U-666
items.summary: The U-666 was a Nazi U-Boat that was built with cursed metal and leviathan bones that was possessed by Mephisto. It was destroyed by the Soldier Supreme.Avengers Vol 8 57

items.title: Universal Eye
items.summary: The Universal Eye was a device attached to the hand of Eson the Searcher which he used to analyze the underater kingdom of Lemuria.Eternals Vol 1 10

items.title: Brain-Mine
items.summary: Brain-Mine's were a small device that the Deviants could place on the forehead of the Eternals to paralyze them.Iron Man Annual Vol 1 6

items.title: Molecular Disruptor
items.summary: The Molecular Disruptor was a device that the Deviants used on the Eternals to seperate their mind from control of their body, effectivly killing them before the body would be disintergrated inside the Abattoricon.Iron Man Annual Vol 1 6

items.title: Abattoricon
items.summary: The Abattoricon was a device that the Deviants used on the Eternals to disintegrate their bodies so Tode could inhale their molecules to gain immortality.Iron Man Annual Vol 1 6

items.title: Leech Manacles
items.summary: The Leech Mancacles are manacles used by the Eternals to disable the powers of its wearers. The Delphan Brothers used a pair of the manacles to capture Sersi to bring her back to Olympia. When Maelstrom took control of Olympia after the Eternals became the Uni-Mind, he used them to disable Wasp’s powers.

items.title: Power Siphon
items.summary: The Power Siphon was a device used by Maelstrom to leech the energy from the vulnerable Uni-Mind, from which all of the Eternals had formed. It consisted of a harness worn by Maelstrom and a larger construct responsible for performing the energy siphoning. Maelstrom was unable to complete the Uni-Mind siphon when Vision had identified his weakness to be non-kinetic energy.Avengers Vol 1 248

items.title: Information Womb
items.summary: The Information Womb was a device created by Spider-Man and Black Panther under the request of Captain Marvel which floods Ulysses with current events data in hopes of triggering a vision.All-New, All-Different Avengers Vol 1 13

items.title: Vidar's Staff
items.summary: Vidar's Staff was a staff enchanted by Odin and wielded by his son Vidar. During a brief clash with Odin in the halls of the palace in Asgard, Thor marveled that Vidar was able to stop Mjolnir with just his staff.Thor Annual Vol 1 12

items.title: Dirigi-Carrier
items.first_appearance: X-Men Noir: Mark of Cain Vol 1 4
items.summary: The Army Air Force built a "Dirigi-Carrier", a airborne battleship kept in midair by dirigibles right underneath the vessel. The Dirigi-Carrier was used as the base of the Office of National Emergency (O*N*E*).X-Men Noir: Mark of Cain Vol 1 4

items.title: Solveig's Golden Waistband
items.summary: Solveig's Golden Waistband was a belt worn by Solveig when she was killed at Vidar's Farm by a trio of Storm Giants. Horvald took the belt from her corpse and took his castle where it was later taken by his wofe Thrunhild. Vidar sought revenge for the murder of his wife and encountered Thrunhild wearing the belt. Thinking she was responsible for killing his wife, Vidar killed her in a rage and later doscovered that she was innocent.

items.title: Battlecarrier Pericles
items.summary: The Battlecarrier Pericles was the base of operation of Field Director Phil Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. team.All-New, All-Different Point One Vol 1 1

items.title: Alien Abductee Express
items.summary: The Alien Abductee Express was a bus used by a group of alien enthusiasts but they were killed and the bus destroyed by the Highwayman.Ghost Rider Vol 6 34

items.title: X-Ray Camera
items.summary: The X-Ray Camera was a large x-ray device created by Reed Richards. He used the device to try to better understand the nature of the invisibility powers of Sue Storm.

items.title: Deathbots
items.first_appearance: Silver Surfer: Lunacy in Latveria Vol 1 4
items.summary: Deathbots were small robots unleashed by Doctor Doom on Wolverine, Hulk, and Spider-Man when they attacked Castle Doom to rescue Jubilee. The Deathbots were swiftly defeated.Silver Surfer: Lunacy in Latveria Vol 1 4

items.title: Plexi-Glass Prison
items.summary: The Plexi-Glass Prison was a prison created by Doctor Doom. Doom had captured Mister Fantastic and discovered a way to switch bodies with him. He used the stretching powers of Mister Fantastic’s body to overcome Reed in the Doctor Doom armor and put him in the prison, telling the other members of the Fantastic Four that they could keep him imprisoned there until finding a more permanent solution. However, he afterwards revealed to Reed that there was only enough oxygen to breathe for an hour. Re

items.title: Atomic Activator
items.summary: The Atomic Activator was a nuclear powered device created by Reed Richards. When Doctor Doom switched bodies with Richards, he planned to use the device to power the Reducing Ray and shrink the other members of the Fantastic Four to an infinitesimally small size. His plan fell through, however, when they suspected the truth after Doom tried to escape harm and Richards tried to save the other members when the Human Torch created a mirage of a stick of dynamite.

items.creators: Jim Shooter; Bill Mantlo; David Wenzel

items.creators: Jim Shooter; Bill Mantlo; David Wenzel

items.summary: In order to be more similar to Green Goblin, Chasm told the other demons Goblin Queen to make him a Glider, but not an ordinary one: made in the image of coffins, for Grave Goblin.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 6 17

items.title: Wizard's Electromagnetic Force Field
items.summary: Wizard's Electromagnetic Force Field was a force field device used by The Wizard to keep the police from recapturing him at his Glenville house after escaping from prison.Strange Tales Vol 1 105 He used it to lure Human Torch so he could fight him one-on-one to get his revenge from his initial capture.Strange Tales Vol 1 102

items.title: Wizard's Artillery Cannon
items.summary: Wizard's Artillery Cannon was an artillery cannon that The Wizard attempted to use to attack the Human Torch in his Glenville house. The cannon was unsuccessful as Johnny was able to melt the artillery shell prior to it impacting with him.Strange Tales Vol 1 105

items.title: Wizard's Nerve Gas Cannon
items.summary: Wizard's Nerve Gas Cannon was a cannon that The Wizard attempted to use to attack the Human Torch in his Glenville house. The cannon was unsuccessful as Johnny was able to create a flame shield to protect himself from exposure to the nerve gas.Strange Tales Vol 1 105

Unfortunately, during a battle between Fin Fang Foom and the Avengers, Anna's truck was destroyed by a falling Iron Man. After trying her food, Iron Man immediately offered Chef Anna a job.T.E.S.T. items.summary: ''Van Dyne's Guide to Travel in Europe'' is a book of information about several European countries, designed for the use of visitors. For each country, it details specific data such as the population, type of government, languages used, available airports and currency, and information useful for travellers such as requirements for entry or for working there, both bureaucratic and sanitary, and advice about clothing, behavior or tipping, as well as touristic attractions. items.title: Storm Chamber
items.summary: The Storm Chamber was built by Reed Richards and Alyssa Moy with the cooperation of Harvey Elder with the intention of bombarding the Thing with cosmic rays to restore it to its original human appearance.Fantastic Four: Season One Vol 1 1

items.title: Technafoil
items.summary: Technafoil was a conducting material developed by Roxxon and meant to be used in conjunction with advanced generators and described by a company representative at the Nassau County Science Exposition as capable of powering New York City for the cost of what it takes to power the Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree. It was stolen by a group of agents associated with P.R.I.D.E. to help power the P.R.I.D.E. Generator.Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 142

items.title: Windstone Jewel
items.summary: The Windstone Jewel was a large red jewel that was on display at the Maritime Museum in lower Manhattan. It was alleged to have the ability to transport ships at sea large distances in seconds and was attempted to be stolen by agents associated with P.R.I.D.E to help power the P.R.I.D.E. Generator. Captain Marvel stopped the agents from stealing the jewel initially but it was later taken from Avengers Mansion after she offered to keep it safe to the museum’s curator and they infiltrated the mans

items.title: P.R.I.D.E. Generator
items.summary: The P.R.I.D.E. Generator was a device created at the Paulson Foundation by Eric Paulson and William Lorber for the P.R.I.D.E. project with the goal of expelling significant portions of the human population to different dimensions. The generator was seemingly destroyed by Spider-Man and Captain Marvel but this caused Captain Marvel to be incapable of returning from her energy form back to her human form.Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 142 They determined that the generator had not actually been destroyed bu

items.title: Sun Crystal
items.summary: Sun Crystals were handheld crystals used by the Elysian tribe of women warriors in an alternate dimension visited by Spider-Man and Starfox. When facets of the crystals were touched in a certain way, they could be thrown into the air and produce a brilliant trail of flame. These were apparently used to signal other Elysian and to frighten their enemies, the Mahko Clan.Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 143

items.title: Turek Ship
items.summary: The Turek Ships were ships owned by the Turek race of aliens that lived on Battleworld. Thing discovered one while wandering Battleworld with Tarianna, unearthed it, and learned to fly before being attacked by the Silben Fleet. Eventually, he found the Turek people and taught them to fly their disused ship fleet to defends themselves from frequent air raids by the Silbens.Thing Vol 1 14

items.title: Silben Ship
items.summary: Silben Ships were ships that were part of a fleet of ships owned by the Silben alien race, enemies of the Tureks. Thing encountered their fleet after unearthing a Turek Ship and fought them off before meeting the Tureks and teaching them to fly their ships which had fallen into disuse and were only being used to live in.Thing Vol 1 14

items.title: Tantorian P-Z Lanta
items.summary: The Tantorian P-Z Lanta was a gun originally found by the Takers on Battleworld. The gun was programmed to seek out the greatest challenges to its power. It first appeared in the hands of Gruhl of Shalfbut who wanted to use it to shoot The Thing. He used it to vaporize a wall after The Thing bent to pick up a wallet on the ground, and later used it to shoot homing projectiles. items.title: Worthington Private Jet
items.summary: The Worthington Private Jet was a jet owned by Warren Worthington III. It was used as a means of transportation for the Defenders from their headquarters at Angel's Aerie in New Mexico.

items.title: Shafik Wazzan's Pentagram Crystal
items.summary: Shafik Wazzan's Pentagram Crystal was a Crystal created by Shafik Wazzan to imprison the physical essence of Gargoyle, who he had previously captured and imprisoned in his castle in Afghanistan. He was able to communicate with Gargoyle freely while he was trapped inside the Crystal.Defenders Vol 1 136

items.title: X-Sub
items.summary: The X-Club used the X-Sub to extract Asteroid M and help establish Utopia.Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 514Dark Avengers Vol 1 8

items.title: MI-24 Attack Helicopter
items.summary: The MI-24 Attack Helicopter is a helicopter of Russian design produced during the Cold War in still use today. A group of helicopters was used to attack Shafik Wazzan and a group of Mujihideen next to Shafik Wazzan's Castle but Wazzan used his powers of sorcery to destroy one of the helicopters which prompted the Mujihideen chief to spare his life despite an accusation of heresy.Defenders Vol 1 136

items.title: All-Blood
items.summary: '''All-Blood the Necrospear''' is a divine weapon forged by Drorin Runehewer and Carnage using All-Black the Necrosword as a template, granting Carnage power akin to that of Knull.Carnage Vol 3 10 thumb|left|[[Drorin Runehewer (Earth-616)|Drorin Runehewer's draft for All-Blood as a sword]] When Cletus Kasady was reanimated by Knull, he plotted to usurp the dark god's power to become a god of destruction himself.Carnage Vol 3 3 Thwarted by Eddie Brock beating him to the punch,King in Black Vol 1

items.title: All-Terrain Survival Suit
items.creators: Mark Gruenwald; John Byrne; Mark Bright
items.summary: The All-Terrain Survival Suit was an armored suit worn by the Kree warrior Bel-Dann during a confrontation with the Fantastic Four and the Inhumans of Attilan beneath the city. The armor gave him super-human strength and powered weaponry that he used to help him fight off his attackers.Fantastic Four Annual Vol 1 18

items.title: Matter/Antimatter Converter
items.summary: The Matter/Antimatter Converter was a large device that was invented by James Power. Power believed the device would be able to generate near-limitless quantities of energy. Before it was to be tested, a Kymellian named Whitey encountered the Power children and told them that a similar device built by his own people had resulted in the destruction of his home planet. Before dying after an attack by his racial enemy the Snarks, he transferred his innate powers to the Power children turning them i

items.title: Handheld Mutant Detector
items.summary: The Handheld Mutant Detector was a handheld mutant detecting device developed by the National Security Council under Henry Gyrich. Douglas Carmody obtained one from Gyrich because of his belief that the Power Pack children were mutants.Power Pack Vol 1 5

items.title: Ali Babba's Lamp
items.summary: Ali Babba's Lamp was a magic lamp acquired by the Collector. He used it to summon Djinn which he’d instruct to perform various actions, typically capturing or imprisoning his collections.Marvel Team-Up Annual Vol 1 7

items.title: Ali Babba's Flying Carpet
items.summary: Ali Babba's Flying Carpet was a flying carpet obtained by the Collector and used as a short-range transportation device.Marvel Team-Up Annual Vol 1 7

items.title: Kymellian Flute
items.summary: The Kymellian Flute was a flute used by the Collector to control the Xanthian Boulder-Crusher Snake-Eyes, a creature capable of hypnotizing creatures with its gaze. The flute was destroyed during an encounter with Spider-Man.Marvel Team-Up Annual Vol 1 7

items.title: Boxer
items.summary: Boxers were crystalline devices used by the Collector to imprison people. When inside, the boxer would sap the will of its captive making it significantly more difficult to escape its confines. Puck and Sasquatch both managed to destroy the boxers that had landed on them but Aurora had to be broken out of one by Spider-Man.Marvel Team-Up Annual Vol 1 7

items.title: Henry Pym's Adjustable Gas Mask
items.creators: Stan Lee; Larry Lieber; Jack Kirby
items.summary: Henry Pym's Adjustable Gas Mask was a gas mask made of unstable molecules invented by Henry Pym for the U.S. Army. The gas mask was able to shrink in size in conjunction with the shrinking abilities Pym could achieve as Ant-Man. He used it to thwart the Hijacker who would use gas to knock out his victims when robbing his own armored trucks.Tales to Astonish Vol 1 40

items.title: Vanirgeld

items.title: Torrid Twosome Uniforms
items.creators: Stan Lee; Larry Lieber; Jack Kirby
items.summary: The Torrid Twosome Uniforms were uniforms that Johnny Storm created after the Acrobat recruited him to join with him and form the Torrid Twosome. The uniforms were made from unstable molecules in similar fashion to the Fantastic Four Uniforms so that Johnny could flame on and become the Human Torch without burning them. After Johnny was made aware that the Acrobat was only conning him to steal from the Glenville Bank, Johnny threw his uniform away and rejoined the Fantastic Four.Strange Tales Vo

items.title: Acrobat's Asbestos Gun
items.creators: Stan Lee; Larry Lieber; Jack Kirby
items.summary: Acrobat's Asbestos Gun was a gun carried by the Acrobat that could shoot liquid asbestos. He used it on the Human Torch to douse his flame after conning him into robbing the Glenville Bank.Strange Tales Vol 1 106

items.title: Atlantean Hypnosis Statue
items.creators: Stan Lee; Larry Lieber; Dick Ayers
items.summary: The Atlantean Hypnosis Statue was an ancient statue used in ages past by the Atlanteans. items.title: Mento-Scan Device
items.summary: Reed Richards used the '''Mento-Scan Device''' to locate Namor by monitoring the radiation band surrounding the Earth and tuning the device to the special frequency emitted by Namor's protective costume. Because Reed had originally designed Namor's life-support costume, he was familiar with its radiation signature. Using the Mento-Scan Device, Reed was able to determine Namor's location in the South Atlantic Ocean, approximately six hundred miles off the African coast.Fantastic Four Vol 1 147

items.title: Heat-Frame
items.summary: During the Fantastic Four's mission to locate Namor in the South Atlantic Ocean, Johnny Storm wore a '''Heat-Frame''' in addition to taking an Oxy-Pill. The device enabled him to ignite his body beneath the surface, where the surrounding water otherwise made it difficult for him to manage his flame. Johnny used the Heat-Frame while attacking Namor's underwater fortress, although he still experienced difficulty controlling his flame while fighting underwater.Fantastic Four Vol 1 147

locations.title: Washington, D.C.
locations.reality: Earth-One; Earth-Two; New Earth; Prime Earth; Real World
locations.summary: '''Washington, D.C.''' is the capital of the United States. On July 16, 1790, the Residence Act approved the creation of a capital district as permitted by the U.S. Constitution. The District is under the exclusive jurisdiction of the United States Congress and is therefore not a part of any U.S. state. The city and the U.S. state of Washington, which is on the country's Pacific coast, were both named in honor of George Washington, it is also the adopted hometown of The Mighty Amazon herself Won

locations.title: The Bronx
locations.summary: '''The Bronx''' is New York City's northernmost borough, coterminous with Bronx County. The Bronx is located northeast of Manhattan. It is the only one of the city's five boroughs situated primarily on the United States mainland (the others are on islands).

locations.title: Atlantis
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; Earth-Fifty-One; Earth-S; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; Arrowverse; DC Extended Universe; Tomorrowverse: Earth-146
locations.summary: '''Atlantis''' is the ancient sunken kingdom in the North Atlantic. Actually the size of a continent, it is one of the earliest and most highly advanced cultural and magical societies on Earth. It is further divided into city-states like Poseidonis, Tritonis, Venturia, Shayeris and others. By the 21st Century, it was ruled by King Arthur Curry, the hero known as Aquaman, from the capital Poseidonis.

locations.title: Gateway City
locations.reality: Earth-Two; New Earth; DCAU; Prime Earth; Absolute Universe
locations.summary: '''Gateway City''' is a harbor town in California, home to the largest collection of Greek Artifacts outside of Greece. It has, in the past, been the hometown of the Spectre and Wonder Woman.

locations.title: Sto-Oa
locations.summary: '''Sto-Oa''', '''the Light of Oa''', is the primary star of Sector 0. The Sto-Oa star system contains one satellite, the planet Oa.

locations.title: Thierna Na Oge
locations.summary: '''Thierna Na Oge''' is one of several city-states that were once part of the greater Pre-Cataclysmic Atlantean empire. Millennia ago, geological upheaval devastated Atlantis causing the entire continent to sink beneath the waves. While many Altanteans survived to later establish the cities of Poseidonis and Tritonis, others migrated towards the outer regions to develop smaller, simpler settlements.

locations.summary: '''Rhode Island''' is a state in the New England region of the United States. It is the smallest U.S. state by area. The state is called Rhode Island in common usage, but most of the state lies on the North American mainland.

locations.title: Newcastle

locations.title: Kentucky

locations.title: Old Earth
locations.summary: '''Old Earth''' was the location of the first incarnation of the science/adventure team known as Atari Force. In the year 2005, Atari Force began exploring the Multiverse, and relocated to an alternate parallel dimension which they dubbed New Earth.

locations.title: Keystone Motors
locations.summary: '''Keystone Motors''' was an automobile manufacturing firm located in Keystone City, Kansas. It had enjoyed recent success, manufacturing 12% more cars in a quarter than any of its competitors in Detroit. One of its most famous cars was the classic Phoenix Roadster. Its CEO was William Slout.

locations.title: Brooklyn
locations.summary: '''Brooklyn''' (named after the Dutch town Breukelen) is one of the five boroughs of New York City. An independent city until its consolidation into New York in 1898, Brooklyn is New York City's most populous borough, with more than 2.5 million residents.

locations.title: Markovia
locations.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-16; Arrowverse; Black Lightning (TV Series); DCU
locations.summary: DC lore entity: Markovia

locations.title: Rock of Eternity
locations.summary: The '''Rock of Eternity''' is a magical structure that sits in the center of all space and time. It is guarded by the Wizard Shazam and his Champions.

locations.title: France
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-One; Earth-Two; 100 Bullets; American Century; Dakotaverse; Super Friends;
locations.summary: '''France''', officially the French Republic, is a country whose territory consists of metropolitan France in western Europe, as well as several overseas regions and territories. It is is a unitary semi-presidential republic with its capital in Paris.

locations.title: Egypt
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; Earth-Two; Earth-S; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: '''Egypt''' is a transcontinental country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and the Sinai Peninsula in the southwest corner of Asia. It has one of the longest histories of any country, tracing its heritage over millennia. Considered a cradle of civilization, Ancient Egypt saw some of the earliest developments of writing, agriculture, urbanization, organized religion, and central government.

locations.title: Fawcett City
locations.summary: '''Fawcett City''' is an idyllic city located in the American Midwest and the home of the Marvel Family.

locations.title: Nebraska
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Sweet Tooth; DCU; Stargirl (TV Series)
locations.summary: '''Nebraska''' is a state located on the Great Plains of the Midwestern United States and Western United States. The state's capital is Lincoln and its largest city is Omaha.

locations.title: Virginia
locations.summary: '''Virginia''' is a state in the United States, directly south of Washington, D.C. and Maryland. During the American Civil War, it was the scene of much of the eastern theater.

locations.title: Gotham Heights
locations.summary: '''Gotham Heights''' is a neighborhood in Northern Gotham City.

locations.title: Bristol Township
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; Gotham (TV Series); The Batman Saga
locations.summary: '''Bristol Township''' is a civil township in Gotham County, New Jersey. Located on the mainland directly North of Gotham City, it is home to many of its affluent citizens, including Bruce Wayne.

locations.title: Suicide Slum
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; Pre-Zero Hour; New Earth; Prime Earth; Smallville (TV Series); DC Universe Online; Arrowverse: Superman & Lois
locations.summary: '''Southside''', known better by its occupants as '''Suicide Slum''', is a neighborhood in Metropolis that has been known to have a much higher rate of crime than the rest of the city. It is a down market area where many who cannot afford the apartments and penthouses of the main city live, the property prices of the Slums being lower due to the corruption.

locations.title: Bakerline
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; DC Extended Universe; DCU
locations.summary: '''Bakerline''' is one of the six boroughs of Metropolis. It is primarily a middle-class housing community and is the home of the Olsen family.

locations.title: Hob's Bay
locations.reality: New Earth; DCAU; DC Universe Online; Arrowverse: Superman & Lois
locations.summary: '''Hob's Bay''' is the name of a bay on Metropolis's Hob's River. The name "Hob's Bay" was also at times used to refer to that entire neighborhood along the bay, which was more commonly called Southside or Suicide Slum. It was located across the West Metropolis River from the central New Troy district, it connects to the mainland by way of the Hobsneck Bridge.

locations.title: New Troy
locations.summary: '''New Troy''' is one of the six boroughs of Metropolis, located in the heart of the city. It represents the hub of Metropolis's central business district.

locations.title: Stryker's Island Penitentiary
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; Smallville (TV Series); Injustice; Arrowverse: Earth-38; Arrowverse: Superman & Lois; DCU
locations.summary: '''Stryker's Island Penitentiary''' is the name of Metropolis' largest prison facility, as well as the name of the island on which it sits.

locations.title: St. Martin's Island
locations.summary: '''St. Martin's Island''' is one of the six boroughs of the city of Metropolis.

locations.title: Delaware
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Delaware''' is a state located in the continental United States of America.

locations.title: Midvale Orphanage
locations.summary: '''Midvale Orphanage''' is an orphanage located in American Midwestern town or '''Midvale''', which lies somewhere between Metropolis and Smallville. It was home to the heroine known as Supergirl for a while.

locations.title: Midvale
locations.summary: '''Midvale''' was a small suburban town located on the outskirts of Metropolis.

locations.title: Betrassus

locations.title: Staphis
locations.summary: '''Staphis''' was a planet located in Sector 2682. It was home to a species of sentient beetle-like aliens.

locations.title: Slyggia
locations.summary: Located in Space Sector 1418, '''Slyggia''' is home to a race of sentient reptilian beings. While it is commonly known that the Slyggians are a technologically advanced race, little else is known about the world or its people, in spite of the fact that one of its natives, Salaak, was a member of the Green Lantern for many years.

locations.title: Ungara
locations.summary: '''Ungara''' is a planet in Space Sector 2814.

locations.title: Hub City
locations.summary: '''Hub City''' holds the dubious distinction of being one of the most dismal American cities rife with crime and corruption, which even outranked Gotham City. The city is the birthplace of controversial investigative reporter, Vic Sage, also known as the Question.

locations.title: Dreaming
locations.summary: For as long as creatures across the multiverse possessed the ability to dream, the plane of existence known as '''the Dreaming''', more commonly known as '''Dream World''', has always existed. By extension, the Dreaming will continue to exist for as long as life exists in the cosmos. The master of the Dreaming is the godlike entity known as '''Dream''', one of the seven Endless.

locations.title: Paris, France

When he struck out on his own, Nightwing used the city as his base of operations and had his hands full with the criminal element there. The city was destroyed by the Society during ''Infinite Crisis'' and was a nuclear wasteland until its return following ''Flashpoint''.

locations.title: Robinson Park

locations.title: Washington

locations.title: Fourtriss uv Bizarro

locations.title: 30th Century

locations.title: White House
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCU
locations.summary: '''The White House''' is the primary residence and headquarters of the Presidents of the United States.

locations.title: Monarch Theater
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Burtonverse; DCAU; Nolanverse; Lego Batman; Arkhamverse; Lego DC Heroes; Injustice; Batman: The Telltale Series; Gotham Knights (Video Game); DC Extended Universe

locations.title: Vega
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; Earth-Two; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Vega''' is the brightest star in the constellation of Lyra, and the second-brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere, after Arcturus. Its planetary system serves as the home to numerous worlds, including Tamaran (homeworld of Starfire), Okaara (home of the Orange Lantern), and the Citadel empire. The system was historically exempt from Green Lantern jurisdiction due to a pact with Larfleeze.

locations.title: Starlag

locations.title: Kuraq

locations.title: Blue Valley

locations.title: Antimatter Universe
locations.summary: The '''Antimatter Universe''' is an anti-matter cosmos occupying the same continuum space but on a different space-time level. Crews located at Belle Reve often make use of a the nearby '''Yeager Field''', an airfield that of military origin that was later abandoned and repurposed for Task Force X use.

Over the years however, Alcatraz has been the scene of several escape attempts and fights between super-powered combatants.

locations.summary: Located in Metropolis, the '''Athenian Women's Shelter''' is a privately owned non-profit organization ostensibly owned and operated by the Greek Goddess Athena.

locations.title: Atlantic City
locations.summary: '''Atlantic City''' is a city in New Jersey, just south of Bludhaven. It's noted for its many casinos.

locations.title: Dominion
locations.reality: Pre-Zero Hour; New Earth; Prime Earth; Arrowverse
locations.first_appearance: Superboy and the Legion of Super-Heroes Vol 1 225
locations.summary: '''Dominion''' is the home world of the Dominators.

locations.title: Pentagon
locations.summary: '''The Pentagon''' is the headquarters of the United States Department of Defense, located in Arlington County, Virginia. As a symbol of the U.S. military, "the Pentagon" is often used metonymically to refer to the Department of Defense rather than the building itself.

locations.title: Green Lantern Citadel
locations.summary: The '''Green Lantern Citadel''' was a structure created by Power Ring energy and located in the hills of Southern California.

locations.title: Palomaris
locations.summary: The planet Palomaris was decimated during the Crisis on Infinite Earths event, and as a result, they found themselves in dire need of resources - specifically female Palomarisians.

locations.title: Zamaron
locations.summary: '''Zamaron''' is the home planet of the Zamarons and the Star Sapphire Corps.

locations.title: Iron Heights
locations.summary: '''Iron Heights''' is a maximum security correctional facility located three miles north of Keystone City. Equipped specifically to deal with threats of a super-powered nature, it is frequently populated by members of the Flash's Rogues Gallery. Gregory Wolfe was the prison's former warden, though he is now mayor of Central City.

locations.title: Hall of Justice
locations.first_appearance: Super Friends (TV Series) Episode: The Power Pirate
locations.summary: The '''Hall of Justice''' is an iconic building that serves as a headquarters for the Justice League.

locations.title: Lisbon
locations.reality: Real World; Quality Universe; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Lisbon''' is the capital and largest city of Portugal and mainland Europe's westernmost capital city.

locations.title: Casablanca
locations.summary: '''Casablanca''' is the largest city in Morocco.

locations.title: Morocco
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Morocco''' is a country on the North West tip of Africa.

locations.title: Liverpool
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: '''Liverpool''' is a cosmopolitan port city in north-west England, on the Mersey Estuary. It is the birth place of John Constantine. Liverpool is known for producing musicians, most notably the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Beatles Beatles], and is home to decorated rival football clubs [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liverpool_F.C. Liverpool] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Everton_F.C. Everton], the former of which Constantine supports.

locations.title: Tangier
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: Tangier is a city in Morocco.

locations.title: Brazil
locations.summary: '''Brazil''' is the largest and easternmost country in South America. It is the world's fifth-largest country by area and the seventh largest by population It is the largest Portuguese-speaking country in the world, and the only one in the Americas. Bounded by the Atlantic Ocean on the east, Brazil covers roughly half of South America's land area, bordering all other countries and territories on the continent except Ecuador and Chile.

locations.title: Cleveland
locations.summary: In the 1930s (on Earth-Two), '''Cleveland''' was known as the base of operations for the mystery man known as Superman.

locations.title: Camden
locations.summary: Camden is a borough in North London.

locations.title: Rome
locations.summary: '''Rome''' is the capital and most populated city of Italy.

locations.title: Washington Monument
locations.summary: The '''Washington Monument''' is a 555 foot obelisk located on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., honoring America's Founding Father, Revolutionary War hero and the first president of the United States of America George Washington.

locations.title: 5252 78th Street
locations.summary: '''5252 78th Street''' was an apartment in Keystone City. For a while, it was the home of Jay and Joan Garrick.

locations.title: Italy
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-One; Earth-Two; 100 Bullets; Air
locations.summary: '''Italy''', officially the '''Italian Republic''', is a unitary parliamentary republic in Europe. Located in the heart of the Mediterranean Sea, Italy shares open land borders with France, Switzerland, Austria, Slovenia, San Marino and Vatican City.

locations.title: Casino Town
locations.summary: '''Casino Town''' is a resort area that is known for its many venues and forms of gambling.

locations.title: Gotham Harbor
locations.summary: The cargo harbor of Gotham City, also known as '''Miller Harbor''', located on the eastern end of the Sprang River.

locations.title: Powers City
locations.summary: Powers City was an American city on Earth-One.

locations.title: Tokyo
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. As a global leader in commerce and politics, it is the flashpoint of many conflicts.

locations.title: Orando
locations.summary: '''Orando''' was a planet in the 30th Century home to Legionnaire Sensor Girl.

locations.title: Empire State Building
locations.summary: The '''Empire State Building''' was, for a long time, the tallest skyscraper in New York City.

locations.title: Harmony, Indiana
locations.reality: Real World; Wildstorm Universe; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Harmony''' is a town in Indiana, United States.

locations.title: South Carolina
locations.summary: '''South Carolina''' is a state in the southeastern region of the United States.

locations.title: Hall of Doom
locations.reality: Super Friends; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; Lego Batman; Teen Titans Go! (TV Series); Arrowverse; DC Super Hero Girls (TV Series); Harley Quinn (TV Series)
locations.first_appearance: Super Friends (TV Series) Episode: Wanted: The Superfriends
locations.summary: The '''Hall of Doom''' was the secret headquarters of the Legion of Doom, as well as the modern incarnation of the Injustice League.

locations.title: New Athens Experimental School
locations.summary: '''New Athens Experimental School''' was a school where Linda Danvers worked as student counselor after graduating from Vandyre University.

locations.title: Hudson River
locations.summary: The '''Hudson River''' is a river separating New York from New Jersey. On either side of its mouth are Jersey City and New York City.

locations.title: Mojave Desert
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: The '''Mojave Desert''', also known as the '''High Desert''', is a desert in the Southwestern United States, mostly located between California, Nevada and Utah.

locations.title: South Africa
locations.reality: Real World; Quality Universe; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: The '''Republic of South Africa''' is the country at the southern tip of Africa. Between 1948 and 1994, the country was locked in the grip of a system of legalized racial segregation.

locations.title: United Planets Government Complex
locations.summary: '''The United Planets Government Complex''' was the central government facility for the United Planets in the late 30th Century.

locations.title: 1938 Sullivan Place
locations.summary: '''1938 Sullivan Place''' is the residence of Clark Kent and Lois Lane in Metropolis.

locations.title: Takron-Galtos
locations.reality: Pre-Zero Hour; Post-Zero Hour; Earth-Prime; Justice League 3000; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: '''Takron-Galtos''' is the principal prison and criminal rehabilitation facility for the United Planets in the 30th century. The planetary prison is largely automated and houses high security inmates from all across the galaxy. The administrative staff at Takron-Galtos consisted of a warden and armed guards from the Science Police.

locations.title: Venezuela
locations.summary: '''Venezuela''' is a country in South America.

locations.title: Titans Lair
locations.summary: DC lore entity: Titans Lair

locations.title: Hatton Corners
locations.summary: Hatton Corners is a small suburban hamlet in a coastal community somewhere in the Eastern United States.

locations.title: Durla
locations.reality: Pre-Zero Hour; New Earth; Post-Zero Hour; Prime Earth; Arrowverse; Arrowverse: Earth-38; Post-Rebirth
locations.summary: '''Durla''' is the only existing planet in the Durla star system.

locations.title: Weber's World
locations.first_appearance: Superboy and the Legion of Super-Heroes Vol 1 241
locations.summary: '''Weber's World''' is an artificial planet. The planet was built to help administer the United Planets Federation governmental operations.

locations.title: Shadowcrest
locations.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth; Smallville (TV Series); Sphere of the Gods
locations.summary: '''Shadowcrest''' is the ancestral home of the Zatara family. When Zatanna inherited it, she used it as an occasional getaway and research base.

locations.title: North Pole
locations.summary: The '''North Pole''' is the northernmost point on the Earth, lying antipodally to the South Pole in the middle of the Arctic Ocean.

locations.title: Glastonbury
locations.reality: Real World; Camelot 3000; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Glastonbury''' is a small town in Somerset, England.

locations.title: Scotland
locations.summary: Scotland is the northernmost country in the United Kingdom, with England located to the south of it. Notable citizens inlude the Mirror Master and Silver Banshee. Notably, Bruce Wayne is of Scottish descent.

locations.title: Maine
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; New Earth; DC Extended Universe
locations.summary: '''Maine''' is a state in the New England region of the northeastern United States, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the east and south, New Hampshire to the west, and Canada to the north.

locations.title: New Orleans
locations.summary: '''New Orleans''' is the largest city in the state of Louisiana.

locations.title: Vietnam
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Watchmen; Earth-21; Watchmen (Movie); Watchmen (TV Series); Arrowverse
locations.summary: '''Vietnam''' is a country in Southeast Asia.

locations.title: Korbal
locations.summary: Korbal is a small planetoid based in the same solar system as the the planet Winath.

locations.title: 31st Century
locations.summary: The '''31st century''' is a future century of the Common Era in accordance with the Gregorian calendar. It will begin on January 1, 3001, and conclude on December 31, 3100, marking the first century of the 4th millennium.

locations.title: New Mexico
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: '''New Mexico''' is a state in the Southwestern United States of America, located on the border with Mexico between Arizona and Texas.

locations.title: Terra Obscura (Earth-ABC)
locations.summary: '''Terra Obscura''' is the name given to another Earth by Tom Strong. It is not in a parallel Universe, but rather on the far side of the Galaxy from Tom's own Earth.

locations.title: Ravenscar Secure Hospital
locations.reality: New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth; Constantine (Movie); Arrowverse
locations.summary: '''Ravenscar''' is a mental health facility located in England.

locations.title: Casanova Club
locations.summary: The '''Casanova Club''' was a nightclub owned by Alex Logue in 1970s Newcastle, England.

locations.title: 19th Century
locations.summary: '''The 19th Century''' includes all events that took place from January 1st of year 1801 to December 31st of 1900.

locations.title: Eiffel Tower
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Donnerverse; Prime Earth
locations.summary: The '''Eiffel Tower''' is a large iron tower in Paris.

locations.title: Invertica City (Earth-ABC)
locations.summary: '''Invertica City''' was the home town of many Science Heroes.

locations.title: Daxam
locations.summary: Daxam is a planet that revolves around a red star.

locations.title: Arlington
locations.summary: '''Arlington''' is a town in Virginia on the south bank of the Potomac River, opposite Washington, D.C.. It is home to a number of government institutions, including the Pentagon.

locations.title: Greece
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Greece''' is a country in Southeast Europe. Located at the southern tip of the Balkan Peninsula, it is bordered by the Aegean, Ionian, and Mediterranean Seas.

locations.title: River Styx
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; DCAU; Sphere of the Gods
locations.summary: The River Styx is a metaphysical river which formed the boundary between Earth and the Underworld, Hades. Charon ferries the dead across the river into any of the realms within the Underworld.

locations.title: Cavern of Souls
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; Sphere of the Gods
locations.summary: The '''Cavern of Souls''', also known as the Well of Souls, is a place in the Greek Underworld and on Themyscira where the souls of women who have died through unjust acts of male violence reside. It is the birthplace of the Amazonian culture.

locations.title: Granny Goodness' Orphanage
locations.reality: Fourth World; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-16; Smallville (TV Series); Sphere of the Gods
locations.summary: The '''Orphanage''' was the mainbase of power of Granny Goodness.

locations.title: Areopagus
locations.summary: The '''Areopagus''' is a hill that exist both in Athens, Greece, and in a subdimension similar to Mount Olympus. It is the abode of the Greek god of war Ares, where not even Zeus can touch him.

locations.title: Stoneworld
locations.summary: '''Stoneworld''' is a planet located in Sector 904. It's the home for a stone-based humanoid species divided in two tribes: the Pumice People and the Obsidian Folk.

locations.title: Dryad
locations.reality: Pre-Zero Hour; New Earth; Post-Zero Hour; Post-Rebirth
locations.summary: The planet '''Dryad''' was home to a race of humanoids dubbed Dryadians.

locations.title: Aegean Sea
locations.summary: The '''Aegean Sea''' is a sea arm of the Mediterranean Sea located between the southern Balkan and Anatolian peninsulas, i.e., between the mainlands of Greece and Turkey respectively.

locations.title: Iraq
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: '''Iraq''' is a country in the Middle East. Located within its current borders are Mesopotamia and the ancient city of Babylon. More recently, it has been the setting of two wars with US involvement, the Gulf War and Iraq War.

locations.title: Challengers Mountain
locations.summary: '''Challengers Mountain''' is the headquarters of the Challengers of the Unknown.

locations.title: Codsville
locations.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Doom Patrol (TV Series)
locations.summary: '''Codsville''', later renamed '''Four Heroes''', was a small fishing town in Maine.

locations.title: Pakistan
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: The Islamic Republic of '''Pakistan''' is a country located in South Asia.

locations.title: Cairo, Egypt
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Prime Earth; Quality Universe; Earth-Two; Wildstorm Universe; DCAU; Earth-One; Super Friends; Earth-ABC; DC Extended Universe
locations.summary: '''Cairo''' is the capital and largest city of Egypt.

locations.title: Doom Patrol Headquarters
locations.summary: The original '''Doom Patrol Headquarters''' was the home of Niles Caulder: a stately townhouse in Midway City sandwiched between two skyscrapers.

locations.title: Dover
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; DC Extended Universe;
locations.summary: '''Dover''' is a city in Kent on the South coast of England. It is famed for its white chalk cliffs.

locations.title: Edmonton
locations.summary: '''Edmonton''' is the capital of the Canadian province of Alberta.

locations.title: British Museum
locations.summary: The '''British Museum''' is a museum in London dedicated to history, art and culture of the world, not just Britain.

locations.title: Hong Kong
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; Pre-Zero Hour; New Earth; Prime Earth;
locations.summary: ''' Hong Kong''' is a city in China, formerly a British colony.

locations.title: Timestream
locations.reality: Multiverse; Earth-One; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth; Pre-Zero Hour; Post-Zero Hour; Earth-ABC; Arrowverse; Doom Patrol (TV Series)
locations.summary: The '''Timestream''', also known as the '''Fourth Dimension''', is an abstract concept used in physics to identify and, when possible, quantify non-Euclidean space/time.

locations.title: Miami
locations.reality: Real World; Post-Zero Hour; Smallville (TV Series); Arrowverse; Gotham (TV Series); American Virgin; Bite Club
locations.summary: '''Miami''' is a city in southeastern Florida. It is the base of operations for the powerful Del Toro Family of vampires.

locations.title: Tibet
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Wildstorm Universe; Prime Earth
locations.summary: '''Tibet''' is a vast geographical region located in the western part of East Asia.

locations.title: Gotham State Penitentiary
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Earth-Forty; Batman (1966 TV Series); Gotham (TV Series)
locations.summary: The '''Gotham State Penitentiary''' was the primary correctional facility of Gotham City prior to the establishment of Blackgate Penitentiary.

locations.title: NORAD
locations.reality: Real World; New Earth; Watchmen; Futures End
locations.summary: '''NORAD''' is a joint organization of the United States and Canada that provides aerospace warning and control for North America.

locations.title: Dalten Towers
locations.summary: Dalten Towers is the base of operations for the Birds of Prey.

locations.title: Holliday College
locations.summary: '''Holliday College''' is a Women's College in the Washington, D.C. area.

locations.title: Transformation Island
locations.reality: Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth 1
locations.summary: '''Transformation Island''' or '''Reform Island''' was a subsidiary island to Themyscira, used by the Amazons for their attempts to rehabilitate the female super-criminal captives of Wonder Woman.

locations.title: Themysciran Embassy
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; Superman: Red Son (Movie)
locations.summary: The '''Themysciran Embassy''' is the main office of Themyscira's diplomatic representatives to United States of America.

locations.title: Io (moon)
locations.summary: '''Io''' is the innermost of the four Galilean moons (the biggest four) of Jupiter.

locations.title: Pyramid of Giza
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth
locations.summary: The '''Great Pyramid of Giza''', also called '''Khufu's''' or '''Cheops' Pyramid''' or the Pyramid of Khufu, and Pyramid of Cheops, is the oldest and largest of the three pyramids near Cairo.

locations.title: Libya
locations.summary: '''Libya''' is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

locations.title: Compound
locations.summary: '''The Compound''' was the home of Superboy on Hawaii.

locations.title: Gotham Clock Tower
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; DC Extended Universe; Arkhamverse
locations.summary: '''Gotham Clock Tower''' is what the name implies - a large clock tower in Gotham City. It was previously the headquarters for both Oracle and the Birds of Prey.

locations.title: Slabside Penitentiary
locations.summary: A metahuman prison, '''The Slab''''s first warden was a man named Dunahy, later replaced by Shilo Norman, a.k.a. the third Mister Miracle. It was originally located in New Jersey, but moved to Antarctica after the disastrous riots of "The Joker's Last Laugh".

locations.title: Hudson University
locations.summary: '''Hudson University''' is located in the city of New Carthage, New York. Notable former students at Hudson University include Dick Grayson, Professor Martin Stein, Crystal Frost, Louise Lincoln and Duela Dent.

locations.title: St. Louis
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; Earth-AD; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth 2; Wildstorm Universe; Titans (TV Series)
locations.summary: '''St. Louis''' is the second-largest city in Missouri, located on the confluence of the Missouri and the Mississippi.

locations.title: Great Divide
locations.summary: The Great Divide is the name given to a massive bottomless pit located in the continent of Atlantis.

locations.title: Mediterranean Sea
locations.summary: '''The Mediterranean Sea''' is an inland sea surrounded by Europe to the north, Africa to the south and Asia to the east. It connects with the Atlantic Ocean through the Strait of Gibraltar.

locations.title: Potomac River
locations.summary: The Potomac is a river that flows through Washington.

locations.title: JFK International Airport
locations.summary: '''John F. Kennedy International Airport''' is the main international airport of New York City.

locations.title: Maryland
locations.summary: '''Maryland''' is a state in the Mid Atlantic region of the United States of America.

locations.title: Chesapeake Bay
locations.summary: The Chesapeake Bay is the largest estuary in the United States. It lies off the Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by Maryland and Virginia.

locations.title: Baltimore
locations.summary: '''Baltimore''' is the largest city in Maryland. It is the home town of Guy Gardner and his brother Mace, who attended Scott Key High School.

locations.summary: '''Shanghai''' is the most populous city in China.

locations.title: New York City Chinatown
locations.summary: '''Chinatown''' can refer to a number of neighborhoods in New York City with a predominantly Asian population, located in Queens and Manhattan.

locations.title: Central America
locations.summary: '''Central America''' is the middle region of the Americas, connecting North America and South America.

locations.title: Belize
locations.summary: '''Belize''' is a country in Central America. Once part of the Mayan, and very briefly the Spanish Empire, it was most recently affiliated with the British Empire, prior to gaining its independence in 1981. The country is bordered to the south and west by Guatemala, to the north by Mexico, and to the east by the Caribbean Sea.

locations.title: Caribbean Sea
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-One; Earth-Two; New Earth; Prime Earth; Quality Universe
locations.summary: The '''Caribbean Sea''' is a marginal sea of the Atlantic Ocean, located south of the Gulf of Mexico and southwest of the Sargasso Sea. The geopolitical region around it is known as the Caribbean, and is bordered to the west by Central America and to the south by South America.

locations.title: Cayman Islands
locations.summary: The '''Cayman Islands''' is a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean Sea.

locations.title: India
locations.reality: Real World; Earth-Two; Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-S; Quality Universe; Air
locations.summary: '''India''' is a country in South Asia, the most populous country in the world.

locations.title: Okaara

locations.title: Changralyn
locations.summary: '''Changralyn''' is a planet in the Vega star system and one of the worlds controlled by the Citadel.

locations.title: Euphorix
locations.summary: Euphorix is one of the twenty-three planets within the Vega star system and one of the few that remained free from the tyranny of the Citadel.

locations.title: Citadel Homeworld
locations.summary: The planet '''Citadel Homeworld''' lies approximately 26 light-years from Earth in the star-system Vega. It is a fortress world surrounded by a ring of asteroids (from the destroyed moon) which have been hollowed out and turned into fortresses.

locations.title: Culacao
locations.summary: '''Culacao''' is a largely unexplored, mineral-poor world of little interest, despite the fact that it is inhabited.

locations.title: Karna (planet)

locations.title: Hny'xx
locations.summary: Hny'xx was a planet in the Vega star system.

locations.title: New Alliance
locations.summary: '''New Alliance''' is a world located in the Vega star system.

locations.title: Sindromeda
locations.summary: '''Sindromeda''' is one of the twenty-three worlds of the Vega star system. The native Sindromedans were mutated by Psions experiments with the gas cloud that surrounds the planet. The other race that exists on the planet is the Graffalloons, who managed to stay unaffected by the genetic change.

locations.title: Emana Branx
locations.summary: The planet '''Emana Branx''' lies approximately 26 light-years from Earth in the star-system Vega.

locations.title: Rashashoon
locations.summary: The planet '''Rashashoon''' lies approximately 26 light-years from Earth in the star-system Vega.

locations.title: Voorl
locations.summary: Voorl is a nearly-dead planet; the fierce native Voorlians have stripped Voorl of all other life forms.

locations.title: Oan Citadel
locations.summary: The '''Citadel of Oa''' is located on the planet Oa, and is the only inhabited area of the entire planet.

locations.title: Korugar City
locations.summary: '''Korugar City''' is the capital city on the planet Korugar.

locations.title: Cheyenne
locations.summary: '''Cheyenne''' is the capital of the U.S. state of Wyoming.

locations.summary: DC lore entity: Slovekia

locations.title: Angor
locations.summary: '''Angor''' is a distant planet that is home to the Champions of Angor.

locations.title: Georgia
locations.summary: '''Georgia''' is a state in the continental United States of America.

locations.title: United Nations Building
locations.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-22; Injustice
locations.summary: The United Nations Building is a distinctive complex in New York City, United States, that has served as the official headquarters of the United Nations since its completion in 1952. It is located in the Turtle Bay neighborhood of Manhattan, on spacious grounds overlooking the East River.

locations.title: Israel
locations.summary: '''Israel''' is a country in the Middle East, taking up the southern half of its Mediterranean coastline.

locations.title: Moscow
locations.summary: '''Moscow''' is the capital city of Russia and is the former capital of Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

locations.title: Gemworld
locations.reality: Earth-One; New Earth; Vertigo Universe; Prime Earth; Sphere of the Gods
locations.creators: Dan Mishkin; Gary Cohn; Ernie Colon
locations.summary: '''Gemworld''' is a magical realm inhabited by humanoid beings who draw power from Earthly gemstones.

locations.title: Wild Lands
locations.summary: The '''Wild Lands''' is an uncharted island located in the Pacific Ocean between the continental United States and Hawaii.

locations.title: Rioguay

locations.title: Neptune (planet)
locations.summary: '''Neptune''' is the eighth planet from the star Sol at a distance of 30.07 A.U.. It is 30,783 miles in diameter. Its day equals 0.73 Earth days and its year equals 164.79 Earth years. The temperature at Neptune's cloud tops is -300 (F and its gravity is 1.12 that of Earth. Neptune is a gas and ice-rich planet much like Uranus and also has a ring-system and a number of moons. The Neptune colonies were established on Neptune's larger moons, Triton and Nereid.

locations.title: Jupiter (planet)
locations.summary: '''Jupiter''' is the fifth planet from the star Sol at a distance of 5.203 A.U.. It is 89,317 miles in diameter. Its day equals 0.41 Earth days and its year equals 11.86 Earth years. Jupiter is a gas giant with no solid surface. The temperature at Jupiter's cloud tops is -235 (F, its gravity is 2.34 that of Earth, and its magnetic field is 20,000 times that of Earth. It has a narrow ring and many moons. The four largest moons are larger than the planet Pluto.

locations.title: Mercury (planet)
locations.summary: '''Mercury''' is the closest planet to the star Sol at a distance of 0.387 A.U.. It is 3,031 miles in diameter. Its day equals 58.65 Earth days and its year equals 87.97 Earth days. With no atmosphere to moderate its environment, the temperature ranges at its surface are extreme. The side of the planet facing away from the Sun is typically a frigid -300 (F while the side facing the Sun reaches a brutal 870 (F. Mercury's gravity is 0.37 that of Earth.

locations.title: Burnside Bridge
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; DC Universe Online; Gotham (TV Series); Arrowverse
locations.summary: The '''Burnside Bridge''' is one of the main bridges in Gotham City in Prime Earth. It crosses the Gotham River and connects Gotham City Chinatown in Downtown Gotham with Burnside on the mainland. Prior to the devastation caused by an earthquake, this bridge was originally known as '''Brown Bridge''', but later almost completely destroyed during the Cataclysm. Following the events of No Man's Land, the bridge was rebuilt and renamed '''Vincefinkel Bridge''' in New Earth continuity.

locations.title: Sargasso Sea

locations.title: Murkton

locations.title: Cadmea

locations.title: Chequerana

locations.title: River Lethe
locations.reality: New Earth; Prime Earth; Earth-1; Sphere of the Gods
locations.summary: '''Lethe''' is the River of Forgetfulness. A fluid body in Hades that acts as a barrier between the living and the dead, and whose waters cleanse and strip the soul of memory.

locations.title: The Fortress of the Knight

locations.title: Planet K
