locations.title: Infanta (planet)
locations.summary: '''Infanta''' is a planet where young women who follow Aphrodite's law and thus gain access to the same immortality as the Amazons while they are still children live in paradise.

locations.title: Duxo
locations.summary: '''Duxo''' was created by Mars as a cruel counterpart to Aphrodite's Infanta. While Infanta was a paradise home to young women who swore loyalty to Aphrodite's teachings of love and were granted immortality in response, Duxo was a torturous prison which boys were abducted to and there forced to become child soldiers.

locations.title: The In-Between
locations.summary: The '''In-Between''' is a void dimension which, according to Deadman, technically does not ''exist'' and, at the same time, it exists everywhere and nowhere. It is a realm of nothing outside the Multiverse where life and death have no meaning: here, even the space-altering abilities of the God Scraper are nullified as it is impossible to escape this dimension.

locations.title: Archive of Worlds
locations.summary: The '''Archive of Worlds''' is an artifical multiverse of pocket dimensions created by the mad god Auteur.io. Each world within it takes the form of a film reel and is based on the exploits of a single hero or villain from Earth 0. It is located on a Waynetech satellite in orbit around Earth.

locations.title: The Wild Realms
locations.summary: The plane of existence known as '''the Wild Realms''' is an ''ethereal dimension'' that is directly connected to The Red. Here, many champions of the Parliament of Limbs fight against each other in The Wild Games, a tournament which decides the animal species that will rule the Earth over the next ten thousand years.

locations.summary: Lower desert area near the border of California and Nevada. Doctor Myron MacLain had a research facility there, studying adamantium. Ultron broke into the facility and used the adamantium to construct a new shell for himself.

locations.summary: '''Mohannda''', officially the '''Republic of Mohannda''', is a country in Africa. It is located north of the technologically advanced nation of Wakanda.Black Axe Vol 1 5

locations.title: Niagara Falls
locations.summary: '''Niagara Falls''' is a massive collection of waterfalls that was naturally formed over the centuries. It is located along the border between Canada and the United States of America, separating the province of Ontario with New York State.

locations.title: Camelot
locations.summary: '''Camelot''' was the legendary kingdom of King Arthur, located in Britain and thriving throughout much of the 6th century.Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe A to Z Update Vol 1 3|; Arthur Pendragon's entry After its fall, the wizard Merlyn transported the kingdom to the other-dimensional realm known as Otherworld.Marvel Legacy: The 1980s Handbook Vol 1 1|; Necromon's entry

locations.title: Brimstone Dimension
locations.summary: The '''Brimstone Dimension''' was an alternate realm which was located in a dimensional rift with a tear and was situated on the Isla des Demonas. It was connected to all points on Earth, along with a few others. Its existence was known to the race of angelic-like Mutants known as the Cheyarafim, who were battling the demonic-looking Mutants known as Neyaphem.Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 431

locations.title: Jajpur
locations.summary: '''Jajpur''' (or '''Jajpore''') is a town in Jajpur District of Odisha in India. It is popularly known as '''Biraja Khetra''', which translates as "the place sacred to Goddess Biraja." Jajpur is located on the banks of the Vaitarani river. Not to be confused with Jajpur Road, another town in the Jajpur district.

locations.title: King Solomon's Tomb
locations.summary: The tomb of King Solomon is a massive burial chamber located in the Atlas Mountains in northwest Africa. It was erected between 970 and 928 BCE. In addition to housing the remains of King Solomon, it also contains an immense chamber filled with riches. The most notable item discovered within the tomb were a pair of twin brass frogs. Each frog possessed remarkable abilities. One frog functioned as a time machine, while another could warp space. When used in concert, the frogs could alter reality.

locations.title: Kakaranthara
locations.summary: Planet of Fin Fang Foom's birth.

They lived an idyllic existence there, but possessed a deep longing to discover how and why their race existed, driving them to leave the Moon and search the universe for answers. Having found none, the entire S'raphh race fell into a deep depression and committed mass suicide by flying into the great oceans of fire that once covered the Moon. In other words, the Godwheel is a continuous, habitable area that physically covers the same surface area as the orbit of Jupiter around the Sun. The Godwheel contains many realms at the same time. locations.title: Malibu
locations.creators: Roy Thomas; Jean Thomas; Gerry Conway; Mike Ploog
locations.summary: '''Malibu''' was a city in Los Angeles County, California.Marvel Spotlight Vol 1 2

locations.title: Dodge City
locations.summary: '''Dodge City''' was a community in Kansas, near the area of operations of western heroes such as Wyatt Earp, Two-Gun Kid, Rawhide Kid, Kid Colt, and the Phantom Rider. It was also the base of a ruffian and gambler by the name of "Faro" John Hobart.

locations.title: Seattle Core
locations.summary: Run by the Sugar Man and Quietus, the Seattle Core was a slave pit in Seattle, Washington where humans were worked to death for an unknown purpose. At one point, it was raided by the members of Generation Next as they attempted to free Colossus' sister, Illyana.Generation Next Vol 1 1|4

locations.title: Winzeldorf
locations.summary: Winzeldorf was a small village located in the Bavarian Alps in southern Germany <small>(see notes)</small>. It consisted of a small church which was located on a mountain above the village, and timbered houses which were built in typical Bavarian fashion. The village was surrounded by high, snow-peaked mountains and dense woods. A fountain with a bird- or angel-like statue marked the central market square. The city was famous for hosting a seasonal circus.

locations.title: Kent (Connecticut)
locations.summary: '''Kent''' was a town in Connecticut, United States of America where Laurie Collins was born.New Mutants Vol 2 11

locations.title: Santiago de León de Caracas
locations.summary: '''Caracas''', officially Santiago de León de Caracas, was the capital, the center of the Greater Caracas Area, and the largest city of Venezuela.

locations.title: Flight Ranch

locations.summary: The planet '''Krylor''' was the third planet from the star Aceta System, in the Andromeda Galaxy, and the homeworld of alien techno-artist, Bereet.Incredible Hulk Vol 1 269

locations.title: Mexico City
locations.summary: '''Mexico City''' is the capital and largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. Mexico City is one of the most important cultural and financial centers in the world. It is located in the Valley of Mexico, a large valley in the high plateaus in the center of Mexico.

locations.title: Stockholm
locations.summary: The capital of Sweden where Bruce Olafsen was born.

The Cotati created a vast garden and the Kree constructed a magnificent city. The Kree could not stand to lose the competition, and at night they killed almost all Cotati and the Skrull crew of the visiting spaceship. locations.title: World Complex Headquarters
locations.summary: When Boom-Boom was found by the Beyonder, he brought her to a distant planet that he called "World Complex Headquarters" of the alien Celestials. There, threatening to destroy the universe, the Beyonder fought and seemingly defeated a number of Celestials.Secret Wars II Vol 1 5 However, that planet was not truly the Celestials' headquarters, and the Celestials allowed the Beyonder to "defeat" them, presumably in order to observe him in action.Fantastic Four Annual Vol 1 26

locations.title: Roanoke Island
locations.summary: The Roanoke Colony, also known as the Lost Colony, was established on '''Roanoke Island''' in what is today's Dare County, North Carolina, United States of America. It was a late 16th-century attempt by Queen Elizabeth I to establish a permanent English settlement. The colony was founded by Sir Walter Raleigh.

locations.title: Temple of the Madri
locations.summary: Church in Quebec, Canada, where Jamie Madrox was kept and his duplicates, the Madri originated from. When Apocalypse captured Bishop he would have him sent there to have his mind probed by the Shadow King and tortured by AbyssAmazing X-Men Vol 1 3. When the X-Men would come to rescue him, Jamie Madrox would commit suicide to stop the Madri, and Abyss would be slainAmazing X-Men Vol 1 4.

locations.title: Quebec
locations.summary: Quebec was a Canadian province located on the east coast of Canada. It is known for it's predominantly French speaking population. Its capital was Quebec City.

locations.title: Greenland
locations.summary: '''Greenland''' was an island region within the kingdom of Denmark that was located between the Northern Atlantic and Arctic Oceans where North America nears Europe. In the Modern Age, it was the largest island on the planet Earth.

locations.title: Mount Vesuvius
locations.summary: '''Mount Vesuvius''' is a Volcano located in Campania, Italy, east of Naples and a short distance from the shore. It is one of several volcanoes which form the Campanian volcanic arc. It has erupted more than 50 times, the most famous eruption taking place in the year 79 A.D., when the volcano buried the ancient Roman city of Pompeii under a thick carpet of volcanic ash.

locations.title: Daily Grind
locations.summary: '''Daily Grind''' was a small coffee shop run by Shirley Washington. Ben Reilly worked here during his stint as Spider-Man.

locations.title: Solar System
locations.summary: '''Sol''', or the '''Solar System''', is a star system within the Milky Way galaxy. locations.title: Demonica
locations.summary: Demonica was the name given to the island nation created by Doctor Demonicus using artificially advancing the natural evolution of a landmass in the Pacific Ocean, and ruled by him. Within hours of being raised from the ocean floor, Demonica was recognized as a sovereign nation by the United Nations. Demonicus populated his country with criminals from a variety of nations. Demonica eventually sank beneath the sea after an earthquake created by a Klaw out-of-control sound weapon.

locations.summary: Piccadilly Circus is a famous traffic intersection and public space of London's West End in the City of Westminster.

locations.title: Elizabeth Tower
locations.summary: '''Big Ben''' was the nickname for the "Great Bell" of the clock at the north end of the Palace of Westminster in London, England. The name and often extended to refer to the clock and the clock tower. The tower is officially known as '''Elizabeth Tower'''.

locations.title: Newfoundland and Labrador
locations.summary: Labrador is a region of Atlantic Canada. Together with the island of Newfoundland from which it is separated by the Strait of Belle Isle, it constitutes the province of Newfoundland and Labrador. The region is part of the much larger Labrador Peninsula. The area was known by the Norse as Markland.

locations.title: Yukon
locations.summary: '''Yukon''' was a territory of Canada located in the northwestern region of the country and bordered the state of Alaska.

locations.title: Prince Edward Island
locations.summary: '''Prince Edward Island''' (or PEI) was the smallest of all the Canadian provinces.

locations.title: New Brunswick
locations.summary: '''New Brunswick''' was the seat of Middlesex County located in eastern New Jersey.

locations.title: Regina
locations.summary: Regina was one of several ''Origin Bomb'' sites created by Ex Nihilo's attempt to make the Earth sentient. The Regina site was labelled "evolution." When the Canadian team, Omega Flight investigated on behalf of Department H, they found that all the residents had been killed or transformed. The Avengers investigated and found Validator still "alive" but she disappeared. The city was quarantined.Avengers Vol 5 9|10

locations.summary: West Edmonton Mall is the largest shopping center in North America. locations.title: East Prussia
locations.summary: '''East Prussia''' was a province of the Kingdom of Prussia and the Free State of Prussia from 1773 to 1829, and from 1878 to 1945. After the World War II, it was divided among several countries, including Union of Soviet Socialist Republics and Poland.

The capital city was Cardiff home to the Welsh Government.

locations.title: Syrian Arab Republic
locations.summary: thumb|left|Flag of Syria '''Syria''' is a country in the Middle East. De jure Syrian territory borders Lebanon and the Mediterranean Sea to the west, Turkey to the north, Iraq to the east, Jordan to the south, and Israel. The historical region of Syria encompassed a larger area, including parts of modern-day Syria, Lebanon, Jordan, and Israel.

locations.title: Himalayas
locations.summary: The '''Himalayas''' are a mountain range in the Indian subcontinent, which separates the Indo-Gangetic Plain from the Tibetan Plateau. The mountain range spreads between Nepal, an independent country, and Tibet, which is part of China. This mountain range is home to nine of the ten highest peaks on Earth, including the highest above sea level, Mount Everest.

locations.title: Australia
locations.summary: Australia is a continent comprising the Australian mainland, New Guinea, Tasmania, Ashmore and Cartier Islands, Coral Sea Islands and intervening islands, all of which sit on the same continental shelf. These landmasses are separated by seas overlying the continental shelf — the Arafura Sea and Torres Strait between Australia and New Guinea, and Bass Strait between mainland Australia and Tasmania.

locations.title: Black Forest
locations.summary: The '''Black Forest''' (German: "Schwarzwald") was a region in the southwestern part of Germany that belonged to the Federal State of Baden-Württemberg. In the west, the Black Forest borders France, while in the east it is bordered by the Rhine Valley. Another important river is the Danube.

locations.title: Castle of Baron Christian Wagner
locations.summary: The Castle of Baron Christian Wagner was located in the Bavarian Alps. The age of the castle is unknown. locations.summary: '''Greenwich''' was a district of South East London, England, located in the Royal Borough of Greenwich. locations.creators: Andrew J. Offut; Roy Thomas; Esteban Maroto
locations.summary: The Tavern of Hilides was one of Khauran City's most popular watering holes. When Shubal and Conan came here to meet Nebinio, Mishi distracted the Cimmerian to let Arkhaurus' assassins execute the Nemedian tanner.Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 218

locations.creators: Robert E. Howard; Roy Thomas; John Buscema
locations.summary: '''Luxur''' was the capital of Stygia in the Southern Kingdoms of Hyboria.Conan the Barbarian Vol 1 84

locations.summary: The '''River Styx''', or '''Nilus''' was the greatest river of the Hyborian world-continent,Handbook of the Conan Universe Vol 1 1|; Stygia's profile and marked the border between the Southern Kingdoms of Shem and Stygia.

locations.title: Bakhr River
locations.summary: The Bakhr was a tributary of the River Styx. Stornella and Valxavier, returning from Shem with Rosina, journeyed along the western bank of the Bakhr until Luxur came into view.Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 216

locations.title: Yahlgan
locations.summary: Located on the edge of glacier in northern Turan, the nigh-forgotten city of '''Yahlgan''' was long sacred to the Hyrkanians' god, Erlik. When Svenno, Grimm, and their Aesir raiders approached the towering citadel, they were ambushed by the fabled black monks of Yahlgan. Svenno managed to escape, but left Grimm behind, who was then captured and tortured by the fanatical troops for years to come.Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 219

locations.title: Warwick Enterprises
locations.summary: Located in a Long Island industrial park, this was where Enos Warwick produced his sonic enhancers. Chance and Cardiac sneaked into the factory the same night, each for their own reasons. At the time, Warwick was overseeing a shipment of his machines. Chance attacked Warwick and would have killed him, but Cardiac, who wanted nobody to die and instead to shut down Warwick's operations, intervened. locations.title: Polaski Towers
locations.summary: The Polaski Towers were an Uptown residential complex where the Chameleon, under the identity of retired detective Terry Martin, built a penthouse refuge. There he hired Tracer to protect him from Spider-Man and then got away before Spidey could find him.Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 211

locations.title: Ryan Mental Hospital
locations.summary: The '''Ryan Mental Hospital''' was the last stop for the worst of the worst. After his arrest, the Master of Vengeance was sent to Ryan Mental Hospital where, under the care of Dr. Tarantino, he was drugged into a manageable state. However, Faron eventually managed to fake taking his medication, and after a week, he regained his full power and mental acuity. He faked hanging himself, causing the guards to come rushing into his cell. He then ambushed and killed them, and Tarantino as well.Spectac

locations.title: Venarium
locations.summary: Venarium was an Aquilonian fortress within Cimmerian territory and manned by Gundermen. Venarium represented the efforts of Aquilonia to further expand its borders, as they were attempting to colonize the areas of southern Cimmeria and permanently annex them. The stronghold was eventually attacked and destroyed by the united Cimmerian tribes.Conan the Adventurer Vol 1 1

locations.title: Giza
locations.summary: The '''Giza''' is a city in Egypt located right next to the '''Giza Plateau''', which contains the Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx.

locations.summary: After Spider-Man, assisted by the original X-Men, broke up a robbery, Professor Power attacked them, endangering onlookers including Peter Parker's alleged parents. locations.summary: Bloody Mary came to 76<sup>th</sup> Street to assassinate a suspected sexual murderer named Jack Morray, but Spider-Man intervened and she was forced to flee.Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 213

locations.summary: The ''Star Well I'' was a five-mile-long space station, covered with reflective panels and storage units for solar radiation. It was the brainchild of Roxxon Oil Corporation employee Arthur Dearborn, who designed it to obtain cheap, clean, solar energy and then send it to Earth so it could be sold as electricity, as an answer to the peak oil crisis. locations.title: Macro Science Museum

Shortly after the presentation, the auditorium was evacuated, due to a blackout; Haney stayed behind with the suit but was murdered by an unknown party, who proceeded to steal the FACADE armor, although not before being photographed by Daily Bugle photographer Lance Bannon. locations.creators: | First = Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 42
locations.summary: '''Lake Zuad''' was a swampy territory located in northern Darfar, close to the Stygian border, where Conan, Valeria, and Zarallo's Free Companies were attacked and kidnapped by the cannibal tribe of the Moon-Eaters. Thanks to a sizable pellet, which could emit thick black smoke, the Cimmerian eventually managed to trick the Darfari, free his companions, and flee towards Sukhmet.Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 225

locations.title: Sukhmet
locations.summary: '''Sukhmet''' was a declining city located on the southern border of Stygia where the Zingaran mercenary Zarallo moved his Free Companies, including Conan, to watch over the cannibals of neighboring Darfar. After the Cimmerian returned from Lake Zuad with Valeria, she also joined the mercenary band, but after killing Captain Makhis, she was forced to leave the city, followed by Conan.Savage Sword of Conan Vol 1 225

locations.summary: During the Hyborian Age, Zabhela was a city on the southern part of the coast of Kush.Conan Saga Vol 1 5|; The Regions of Stygia map

locations.summary: '''Sadoria''', once a garden spot, a flower of Western Zingara, became ruined after the civil war. Conan, Delmurio, and Tetra managed to overthrow Marshall Barabbus' tyrannical rule and left the city in the hands of the exiled Zingaran children.Conan the Barbarian Vol 1 174

locations.title: Zingara
locations.summary: '''Zingara''' was one of the main naval and commercial powers of the Hyborian world, though second to its main rival Argos.Handbook of the Conan Universe Vol 1 1|; Zingara's profile As part of their rivalry, Zingara once organized a group of Freebooters. They were supposed to serve as licensed privateers and perform the patriotic duty of disrupting foreign trade. locations.title: Cascan
locations.summary: Cascan was a less-than-nothing fishing village built into the side of a hill crest on the Thunder River, ravaged by the civil war in Zingara. Needing a boat to sail downriver to get to Argos, Conan, Delmurio, and Tetra were approached by a blind man called "Bracca," who offered to escort them. Several days later, Bracca revealed himself as a demon who used to attack the fishermen and the sailors, but he was eventually thrown overboard by Conan.Conan the Barbarian Vol 1 175

locations.creators: Bill Everett; Carl Burgos; John Compton; Ray Gill

By mutual consent, no weapons could be drawn in there, and all disagreements were settled hand-to-hand on the dais. While Andamo and Conan were having a drink, the tavern was attacked by Lord Ludox's Homunculus. The Cimmerian managed to save Andamo's life by ripping off his mark of Pollus.Conan the Adventurer Vol 1 3

They were traditionally outlaws who preyed on trade caravans and other travelers. They had a reputation of being fierce fighters and had resisted attempts of larger nations to annex them.
